briefTitle: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of a Supplement on Urinary Symptoms
officialTitle: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of a Supplement on Urinary Symptoms

eligibility.text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Be female
* Be aged 18-45
* Is sexually active and engages in sexual activity at least twice per week
* Has had either two or more episodes with symptoms associated with UTIs in the past six months (including frequent and urgent urination, a burning sensation during urination, and cloudy urine), or three or more episodes with symptoms associated with UTIs in the past 12 months (including frequent and urgent urination, a burning sensation during urination, and cloudy urine)
* Self-reports recurrent symptoms associated with UTIs specifically after sex (including frequent and urgent urination, a burning sensation during urination, and cloudy urine) requiring administration of antibiotics, and self-reports sex as a predominant trigger (UTI onset typically 24-48 hours after intercourse)
* BMI below 30 kg/m²
* Generally healthy - does not live with any uncontrolled chronic disease
* If taking oral over-the-counter supplements or herbal remedies targeted at symptoms associated with UTIs, must have been consistently taking these for at least 3 months before starting the study and be willing to maintain this routine for the study duration
* Willing to keep all elements of their female hygiene routine the same for the duration of the study
* Willing to maintain the same diet and exercise regimen consistently throughout the study duration
* Resides in the United States

Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently taking the anticoagulant warfarin
* Currently taking antibiotics or who will be during the trial period (not including those prescribed for an acute urinary tract infection)
* Currently taking prophylactic antibiotics for urinary tract infections, either taken daily or taken before sex
* Diagnosed with a sexually transmitted disease within the last three months (e.g., chlamydia, trichomoniasis, gonorrhea, genital herpes)
* History of interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome, overactive bladder, pelvic floor dysfunction, or other conditions that can mimic UTI symptoms
* Pre-existing chronic conditions that would prevent adherence to the protocol, including oncological and psychiatric disorders
* Planned invasive medical procedures during the study period
* Planning to introduce any products or new forms of prescription medication or supplements that target symptoms associated with UTI for the study duration
* Any allergies or sensitivities to any of the study product ingredients
* Any woman who is pregnant, breastfeeding, or trying to conceive (or who will be at any point during the study period)
* Unwilling to follow the study protocol
* Has stopped or started using hormonal birth control in the past month
* History of substance abuse
* Currently partaking in another research study or who will be partaking in any other research study at any point during this study's duration
